# FreeSportsPicks.pro
# https://www.freesportspicks.pro
# Last updated: June 28, 2026

## About
FreeSportsPicks.pro is a free AI-powered sports picks and predictions website providing expert analysis for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, college football, college basketball, soccer, golf, MMA, horse racing, and tennis. All picks are 100% free with no subscription required. Picks are generated daily by AI (Groq/LLaMA) and posted at 9 AM ET. We operate 21 Telegram channels across 19 countries. Launched June 2026.

## What We Offer
- Free daily AI-powered sports picks for all major sports
- Verified public track record — wins AND losses tracked transparently
- Game of the Day feature on homepage updated daily at 1 AM ET
- 21 Telegram channels in English and 18 other languages
- Premium 3-pick cards available via TON crypto on Telegram
- Free blog with 50+ sports betting strategy guides
- Email capture via guestbook for daily pick delivery
- Fully automated — picks generated, posted, and tracked automatically

## How Our Picks Work
AI system (Groq LLaMA-3.3-70b) fetches live game data from TheSportsDB daily at 1 AM ET, generates picks with reasoning, saves to Supabase, posts to 21 Telegram channels at 9 AM ET, checks results at 2 PM ET, and updates track record automatically.
